title: RES↔ARCH-001: Technology Transfer Review + Long-Term Architecture Roadmap for Research
description: The Embedded Systems Architect provides the long-term architecture roadmap (platform-evolution direction, planned protocol/technology shifts, technology-horizon challenges and architectural constraints that seed research), engineering-feasibility feedback on research findings at PoC (Proof-of-Concept) review, system-level constraints for experimental design, and ADR notifications with research implications; the Researcher provides Technology Transfer Packs, Feasibility Assessment Reports for novel sensing/communication/computation paradigms, and PoC demonstrations with characterized performance metrics. Grounded in EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_ARCHITECT_SKILL §6.12 and IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.1. The Technology Transfer Pack artifact itself (TRL ≥ 5 transfer gate) is schematized separately as RES↔ARCH-TTP-001 (cross-referenced, not duplicated here); this contract carries the bilateral review-verdict + roadmap exchange.

architecture_roadmap_for_research.description: ARCH→RES: long-term roadmap + system-level constraints seeding research.

system_level_constraints.description: Resource budgets the Researcher designs experiments against (for eventual technology transfer).

technology_transfer_review.description: ARCH→RES: written feasibility verdict on a submitted Technology Transfer Pack (provided ≥1 week before the review).

assessment_delivered_business_days_befor.description: Architect provides written feasibility assessment ≥1 week (≥5 business days) before the review meeting.

adr_research_notification.description: ARCH→RES: ADR with research implications, notified within 5 business days of acceptance.

research_submission.description: RES→ARCH: TTP + PoC artifacts submitted ≥3 weeks before the quarterly Technology Transfer Review.

trl.description: Technology Readiness Level; TRL ≥ 5 required to transfer (see RES↔ARCH-TTP-001).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Technology-transfer feasibility review can gate productization (the Technology Transfer Pack requires TRL ≥ 5 to transfer — RES↔ARCH-TTP-001) and the long-term roadmap is strategic and ARB-relevant. Binding transfer decisions are ratified by humans.
x-macp.cadence: CALENDAR + TRIGGER (quarterly Technology Transfer Review — first Tuesday Feb/May/Aug/Nov; TTP submitted ≥3 weeks before, written feasibility ≥1 week before; annual Long-term Architecture Roadmap Briefing first Tuesday March; ADR research-implication notification within 5 business days; ad hoc scientific consultation within 5 business days)
confirm_conditions: a feasibility verdict references a Technology Transfer Pack (ttp_ref)
FEASIBLE_WITH_ARCHITECTURE_CHANGES enumerates the required architecture changes; INFEASIBLE enumerates the gaps
system-level constraints and PoC demo metrics each carry an explicit unit
ADR with research implications notified within 5 business days of acceptance
reject_conditions: a research finding marked for transfer with TRL < 5 (violates the TTP transfer gate — see RES↔ARCH-TTP-001)
a PoC metric or system-level constraint emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a roadmap, platform, protocol, or budget change requiring an ADR recorded without one (Never Silently Deviate)
counter_conditions: a Technology Transfer Pack submitted < 3 weeks before the review — request rescheduling or a scoped interim review (max 2/quarter)
a feasibility assessment requested without characterized PoC metrics — request the performance characterization before a verdict
